7:82.text: And the answer of his people was only that they said: "Drive them out of your town, these are indeed men who want to be pure

7:83.text: Then We saved him and his family, except his wife; she was of those who remained behind

7:84.text: And We rained down on them a rain
. Then see what was the end of the Mujrimûn

7:85.text: their brother Shu‘aib. He said: "O my people! Worship Allâh! You have no other Ilâh
[Lâ ilâha illallâh (none has the right to be worshipped but Allâh)]

from your Lord has come unto you; so give full measure and full weight and wrong not men in their things, and do not do mischief on the earth after it has been set in order, that will be better for you, if you are believers.

7:86.text: "And sit not on every road, threatening, and hindering from the Path of Allâh those who believe in Him, and seeking to make it crooked. And remember when you were but few, and He multiplied you. And see what was the end of the Mufsidûn

7:87.text: "And if there is a party of you who believe in that with which I have been sent and a party who do not believe, so be patient until Allâh judges between us, and He is the Best of judges."
